network_error: No connection. Your work is saved and will send when you're back online.
server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
conflict: This was changed elsewhere. Review the latest version.
idempotency_mismatch: This action was already sent with different details. Please start it again.
invalid_credentials: Phone number or password is incorrect.
otp_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
phone_invalid: Enter a valid Nigerian phone number.
phone_taken: An account already exists for this phone number. Sign in instead.
account_suspended: This account is suspended. Contact WHY ME support.
app_update_required: Please update WHY ME to continue.
capability_required: Turn on selling or services for your account first.
listing_limit_reached: You have reached the number of active listings on your plan. Pause one, or upgrade.
content_blocked: Remove phone numbers, account numbers, emails and links. Buyers contact you through WHY ME.
invalid_transition: This changed meanwhile. Refresh to see its current status.
listing_incomplete: Please complete the highlighted fields before publishing.
terms_required: Please accept the current seller terms to continue.
profile_incomplete: Tell buyers a little more about yourself (at least 20 characters) before publishing.
too_many_photos: You can add up to {{limit}} photos here on your plan.
upload_invalid: One of these photos can no longer be used. Remove it and add it again.
photo_rejected: One of your photos couldn't be read. Replace it with another photo.
photos_processing: Your photos are still being prepared. We will try again shortly.
